Mouhamed Gueye - Out: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
Henri Veesaar - Out: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.
Devin Carter - Out: Carter has been diagnosed with mononucleosis and is without a timetable for a return, Gary Washburn of The Boston Globe reports.

Coby White - Out: Head coach Charles Lee said Monday that White (calf) remains without a timeline for a return, though Lee added that he'll have a better idea of where things stand following the Hornets' two-game road trip, Rod Boone of The Charlotte Observer reports.
Kon Knueppel - Out: Knueppel (hamstring) is without a timetable for a return, Rod Boone of The Charlotte Observer reports.
Grant Williams - Out: Williams (hamstring) will be re-evaluated following Charlotte's upcoming two-game road trip, Rod Boone reports.
Kylan Boswell - Out: Boswell (knee) is out for Wednesday's season opener against the Nets.
Nic Claxton - Out: Claxton (hamstring) participated in individual drills Monday morning and hopes to join the team for practice next week, Joe Cowley of the Chicago Sun-Times reports.
Patrick Williams - Out: Williams (groin) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Celtics.
Caleb Martin - Out: Martin (thumb) is out for Monday's game against the Heat, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.
Naji Marshall - Out: Marshall (illness) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Heat.
Tarik Biberovic - Out: Biberovic (heel) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against San Antonio.
Santi Aldama - Out: Aldama (knee) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Spurs.
Dereck Lively II - Out: Lively (foot) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Pacers.
Alpha Diallo - Out: Diallo (wrist) is out for Monday's game against the Warriors.
Cameron Johnson - Day-To-Day: Johnson (ankle) is doubtful to play Monday against the Warriors.
Spencer Jones - Out: Jones (hamstring) is out for Monday's matchup with the Warriors.
Julian Strawther - Out: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.
Gui Santos - Day-To-Day: Santos is questionable for Monday's game against the Nuggets due to left knee tendinitis.
Brandon Williams - Day-To-Day: Williams is probable for Monday's game against the Nuggets due to left lower back soreness.
Charles Bassey - Day-To-Day: Bassey is probable for Monday's game against the Nuggets due to right patellar tendinopathy.

Kristaps Porzingis - Out: Porzingis is contemplating his future in basketball as he deals with recurring symptoms from the autoimmune condition termed as postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
Moses Moody - Out: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
Jimmy Butler III - Out: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
Steven Adams - Out: Head coach Ime Udoka said Monday that Adams could be out "a week or two" due to his right soleus strain, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.
Marcus Smart - Out: Smart (arm) is out for Monday's game against the Hawks.
Andrew Nembhard - Out: Nembhard (neck/back) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Milwaukee, Dustin Dopirak of The Indianapolis Star reports.
T.J. McConnell - Out: McConnell (hamstring) is out for Monday's game against the Bucks.
Ivica Zubac - Out: Zubac (ankle) is out for Monday's game against the Bucks.
Ben Sheppard - Out: Sheppard has been diagnosed with a torn meniscus in his left knee and is without a timetable for a return to game action, Scott Agness of FieldhouseFiles.com reports.
Johnny Furphy - Out: Furphy was diagnosed with a torn right ACL on Monday and will miss the remainder of the season, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports.
Isaiah Stewart - Day-To-Day: Stewart is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Jazz due to left ankle injury management.
Karim Lopez - Day-To-Day: Lopez (knee) is questionable for Monday's game in Utah.
Donte DiVincenzo - Out: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.
Jalen Williams - Out: Williams has been diagnosed with a dislocated left ankle and fractured fibula, which will require surgery, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Cason Wallace - Out: Wallace has been diagnosed with a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will require surgery, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Nikola Topic - Out: Topic (back) won't play in Monday's game against the Suns, Andrew Schlecht of The Athletic reports.
Thomas Sorber - Out: Sorber (knee) is out for Monday's game versus the Suns, per Andrew Schlecht of The Athletic.
Chet Holmgren - Out: Holmgren (knee) is out for Monday's game versus the Suns.
Otega Oweh - Out: The Thunder plan to waive Oweh (Achilles) on Friday.
Oso Ighodaro - Out: Ighodaro (oblique) is out for Monday's matchup with the Thunder.
Mark Williams - Out: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Jaxson Hayes - Day-To-Day: Hayes is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Grizzlies due to right shoulder soreness, Shreyas Laddha of The Salt Lake Tribune reports.
Trey Alexander - Out: Alexander won't play Wednesday against the Grizzlies due to a left knee bone bruise.
Jusuf Nurkic - Out: Nurkic will miss at least the next four weeks due to a partial plantar plate tear of second toe in right foot, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.

AJ Dybantsa - Out: Dybantsa, who has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Hornets, is progressing well from a left ankle sprain and will take part in on-court activities Tuesday, Josh Robbins of The Athletic reports.
Tristan Vukcevic - Out: The Wizards announced Thursday that Vukcevic (hip) will be re-evaluated in four weeks.
Jamir Watkins - Out: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
Mikael Backlund - Day-To-Day: Backlund (upper body) will be a game-time decision against Toronto on Monday, per Pat Steinberg of QR Calgary 770 AM.
Jonathan Huberdeau - Injured Reserve: Huberdeau (hip) skated with his teammates Saturday, but he isn't close to returning, Pat Steinberg of QR Calgary 770 AM reports.

Igor Shesterkin - Injured Reserve: Shesterkin will require surgery and a lengthy rehab process to address his season-ending right knee injury, Vince Z. Mercogliano of The Athletic reports Sunday.
Joe Veleno - Injured Reserve: Veleno (lower body) was placed on long-term injured reserve Saturday, Vince Z. Mercogliano of The Athletic reports.

Chris Tanev - Injured Reserve: The Maple Leafs announced Thursday that Tanev (lower body) is considered week-to-week, Mark Masters of TSN reports.
Max Domi - Injured Reserve: Domi (back) was transferred from the non-roster list to long-term injured reserve Wednesday, per PuckPedia.
Cade Webber - Injured Reserve: ir-nr
Elvis Merzlikins - Injured Reserve: Merzlikins is expected to miss 4-6 months to begin the 2026-27 regular season while recovering from a shoulder injury, per Luke Fox of Sportsnet.

model_check.rule: v1 is live. v2 is only PROPOSED (switch_ready) when ALL hold on the same graded legs: 100+ graded legs, lower log loss, higher avg CLV vs FanDuel AND vs Pinnacle, 30+ top picks graded and a top-pick win rate (King's Favorite/Best Parlay legs + top leg per game) at least v1's. Even then the user is asked first; it never switches on its own.

sharp_filter.note: Report only: tested live on 2026-10-25, it swapped 16 of 36 game picks and lowered the average Pinnacle-rated win chance of the picks (86.7% -> 85.9%), because the safest alt lines carry the most FanDuel vig. Since the goal is win rate, it stays off.
sharp_filter.rule: Legs dropped when FanDuel's price implies a chance more than 3 pts above Pinnacle's no-vig fair chance (you'd be overpaying vs the sharp market).
